rules.basis: The S48-100LFP sheet states 'Nominal voltage' as 51.2 V; the HL12-580WAGM sheet prints 'Volts' as a bare 12.
The S48-100LFP STACK-LV manual's ratings table prints the bare heading 'Voltage' as 51.2 V beside 'Capacity'; the bare name is read on that manual only.
The S48-100LFP STACK-LV manual states 'Peak DSG Current' as '92 A / 2 mins', the discharge peak with the time it holds.
